CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #17
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Refusing to help a neighbour
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   D. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Hiding stolen items
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   D. Spreading rumours

3. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Story;? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bible Story; to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Bible Story; has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Bible Story; with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible Story;.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Wise men? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Wise men.
   B. Apply the teaching of Wise men with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Use Wise men to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Say Wise men has no place in daily life.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Adam and? (1 mark)

7. Which response best shows understanding of The Bible? (1 mark)

   C. Apply the teaching of The Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say The Bible has no place in daily life.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Bible? (1 mark)
   A. Use Bible to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Bible.
   C. Say Bible has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Bible with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of My Creation? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of My Creation with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use My Creation to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say My Creation has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing My Creation.

10. Which response best shows understanding of The little? (1 mark)
   A. Say The little has no place in daily life.
   B. Use The little to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The little.
   D. Apply the teaching of The little with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of The good life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of The good life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Use The good life of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say The good life of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The good life of Jesus Christ.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ? (1 mark)

   B. Use Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Jesus Christ Life of Jesus Christ with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

13. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Destroy trees without planting
   C. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   D. Pollute rivers deliberately

14. Which response best shows understanding of Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ●? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Home town of By the end of the Sub strand, the ●.
